scope: Independent offline M11 adapters and selected companion parity
boundaries: No device access, RF, flashing, provisioning, real credentials or public publication
Synthetic entropy ports prove control flow and output publication, not entropy quality
Memory/NVS call doubles prove adapter policy, not flash retention or power-failure behavior on a target
Pinned stock client requests and source-derived expectations do not qualify physical iPhone or radio interoperability
Target compile, stack/resource audit and standard-profile no-runtime capability audit belong to integration
entropy: No constructor/startup entropy I/O or implicit Bluetooth/PHY/RF enable/wakeup
Invalid lengths, unavailable lease/device/quality and unsupported platform reject before output publication
Partial/zero/error/oversized responses terminate by sampled deadline or independent attempt cap; no weak fallback
Readiness checked before reads and before publication; release failure terminally poisons with no uncertain cleanup retry
All output bytes unchanged on failure; local partial scratch securely wiped
Reentry rejects without releasing or poisoning the current owner lease
nRF pool-only ISR flags=0 path; no K_FOREVER or ENTROPY_BUSYWAIT fallback
ESP32-S3 requires already-enabled awake BT/PHY under nonblocking lease and pinned clock constraints; finite cycle polls; no unsupported SMP/PM
Describe sampled 20ms admission deadline and 64 reads, not a scheduler-independent wall-clock guarantee
storage_lifecycle: Prepare uses an already-initialized backend; no mount, repair, erase, write, initialization, key generation or pin creation
Absent, corrupt, uncertain, oversized, orphaned, duplicate or mismatched state fails closed without fallback
Exact identity CRC node/public key and ledger domain binding; expected local identity independently supplied
Both journal snapshots and monotonic histories validated before capability publication
Only four private namespace keys can be read/written; bounds are explicit
Canonical NVS name/count encodings and full returned lengths checked; bounded scans detect stale counter within supported namespace
Service lock obtained without waiting; storage gate proves RF off/no active work; other settings writers excluded or serialized
Nonce/replay/revocation writes retain all existing domain, failure-burn and tombstone invariants
No automatic retry or recovery after uncertain writes; no default provisioning or trust from NodeInfo/client metadata
CRC is consistency only: no at-rest encryption or malicious coherent rollback protection is claimed
companion: Real stock Python localNode getConfig/writeConfig wire requests accepted for supported DeviceConfig interval field
Interval readback comes from active stored Config, including old valid 60..3599 records
New writes below3600 clamp3600 matching pinned AdminModule; >86400 reject as explicit local bound
Fixed CLIENT_MUTE, serial enabled and heartbeat disabled enforced; unsupported DeviceConfig edits reject
Fully supported equivalent saves outside edit batches do not write, stop RX, disarm, cancel queues or reset discovery
Batch equivalent saves may refresh activity but perform no storage/RF transition
Real interval changes persist through SettingsEdit and disarm TX; write failures remain fail-closed
Discovery reschedules from last admitted time plus new interval, retaining 60s admission and 12h peer reply limits
Clock wrap, shortening below elapsed interval and rearming preserve the existing 30s startup gate where due

pinned_zephyr_entropy_findings.nrf_get_entropy: May wait K_FOREVER; unsuitable for bounded private adapter
pinned_zephyr_entropy_findings.nrf_get_entropy_isr_flags_zero: Finite pool copy, can return partial/zero
pinned_zephyr_entropy_findings.nrf_busywait: Hardware-ready wait is not independently bounded
pinned_zephyr_entropy_findings.esp32_get_entropy: Cycle-count loop and BT/Wi-Fi entropy supply assumptions require separate bounded quality-gated adapter
pinned_zephyr_entropy_findings.sys_rand_get: May fall back to cycle counter; prohibited for private randomness
pinned_zephyr_entropy_findings.sys_csrand_get: Does not itself prove boundedness/readiness of hardware or PSA provider
